_help: Every comment on every reel (words or emoji) gets a DM: 'Send it' button -> follow check -> the link only for followers (non-followers get 'I followed' button; after 3 tries the link is sent anyway). Which DM: the entry bound to THAT reel ('reel'/'reels' link or 'caption_has' tag) whatever the comment says -> only on a reel with no entry, the keyword's entry -> else 'default'. Typed DMs never trigger by keyword. No public replies. A backup check (GitHub Actions, every 10 min) DMs anyone the instant webhook missed.
